title: Native Weil dualizing Hom transposition along a structure adjunction
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use the actual categories $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(T_0)\subset D(\mathcal W_T)$, full subcategories with bounded constructible cohomology, and the actual equivariant derived operations of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], with the tensor, internal Hom and coefficient unit $\mathbf1_0$ of [def-sf-derived-weil-category-and-operations]. Let $T_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, put $s_0=\operatorname{Spec}k_0$, and let $a_{T,0}:T_0\to s_0$ be its structure morphism. Assume that the actual restricted functor $A_T=Ra_{T,0!}$ has a chosen right adjoint $J_T$ on these categories, with adjunction $\alpha_T:A_T\dashv J_T$. Put $\omega_T=J_T\mathbf1_0$ and $D_TK=R\mathcal Hom_T(K,\omega_T)$, restricted to $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(T_0)$ using [lem-sf-weil-verdier-dual-preserves-weil-complexes]. For every $K,L\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(T_0)$, the ambient tensor $K\otimes^L_{B_T}L$ lies in that full subcategory, and there are bijections
$$\operatorname{Hom}_T(L,D_TK)\xrightarrow{c_{T,K,L}}\operatorname{Hom}_T(K\otimes^L_{B_T}L,\omega_T)\xrightarrow{t_{T,K,L}}\operatorname{Hom}_{s_0}(A_T(K\otimes^L_{B_T}L),\mathbf1_0).$$
The map $c$ is the uncurrying map of the native closed derived tensor structure, with internal Hom exactly `ProEtaleWeilSheaf.derivedHom`; the map $t$ is the inverse of the chosen adjunction bijection $\alpha_T$ at $\mathbf1_0$. The Hom sets on $T_0$ are the ambient derived Hom sets identified with the full-subcategory Hom sets. Both bijections, their inverses and their composite are natural contravariantly in $L$ and $K$.

proof.text: Apply nativeDerivedTensor_mem_weilComplex with arguments L,K to obtain bounded constructibility of the ambient native tensor of K,L. The actual native closed comparison and its nativeModel already use exactly the native derivedHom, so no further coefficient-presentation comparison is needed at this assembly step.

The supplied adjunction alpha gives HasUpperShriek for the structure morphism. Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq identifies the library upperShriek with J; evaluate at the coefficient unit and apply the internal-Hom bifunctor to this target isomorphism. Compose with nativeModel at both targets, obtaining an isomorphism from the library derivedHom dual to nativeStructureDual. Transfer objectProperty_derivedHom_dualizingComplex along this isomorphism, since bounded constructibility is closed under isomorphisms.

Construct c by the full-subcategory Hom equivalence, postcomposition with nativeModel inverse, inverse closed transpose for right tensoring with K, precomposition with the braiding from K tensor L to L tensor K, and the inverse full-subcategory Hom equivalence. Its ambient arrow is definitionally nativeDualizingUncurry. Construct t as the inverse alpha.homEquiv at the coefficient unit; this gives the required formula definitionally.

Prove simultaneous contravariant naturality of inverse closed transpose by expanding its counit formula, applying evaluation_naturality in the internal-Hom source, and using tensor interchange. Naturality of nativeModel inverse transports the derivedHom source map to the bifunctor map; braiding naturality changes the tensor order, yielding c naturality. Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm gives t naturality. Compose these equations for the composite bijection. Apply injectivity of c to obtain its inverse square, use homEquiv_naturality_left for the inverse t square, and combine them for the inverse composite square.
